key_conflict_wheel.wheel.title: Conflict Keybind Wheel
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_style: Switch the wheel between Vanilla MC and Translucent
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_handle_move: Hold left button and drag to move the whole wheel
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_handle_scal: Hold left button and drag up/down to scale; scroll to nudge (%s%%)
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_reorder: Hold and drag to reorder this action (slot %s / %s)
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_blacklist: Stop the wheel from taking over this key
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_adjust: Open adjustment mode to move, scale and reorder actions
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_stop: Stop every hold currently running on this key
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_drag_button: Hold right mouse button and drag to move this button row
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_drag_offset: Offset X %s / Y %s · release to save
key_conflict_wheel.hint.zones: Release the key to trigger: inner ring = single press, outer ring = hold (a lit sector = stop), centre hole = cancel / stop holds
key_conflict_wheel.hint.adjust: Hold the "Move wheel" handle at the wheel's bottom-right to reposition it (offset X %s / Y %s) · hold "Scale wheel" and drag up/down to resize (%s%%) · grab any action and drag it to reorder
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.adjust_tip: Click the × outside the ring to clear that action's keybind · Confirm = save position/size/order · Cancel / ESC / right click = revert
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_confirm: Save the position and close the wheel
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_cancel: Discard changes, wheel goes back where it was
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.tip_center: Snap the wheel back to screen center
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.release.long: Releasing now = start holding %s right away
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.release.center_: Releasing now = stop %s hold(s) on this key
key_conflict_wheel.wheel.release.cancel: Releasing now = cancel (move the mouse onto a ring sector)
key_conflict_wheel.msg.blacklisted: [%s] blocked: no wheel from now on, unblock in the K menu
key_conflict_wheel.msg.hold_started: Holding: %s (press %s again and release in the same outer sector to stop)
key_conflict_wheel.msg.pos_saved: Wheel position, size and order saved
key_conflict_wheel.msg.pos_reverted: Discarded: wheel position, size and order reverted
key_conflict_wheel.msg.unbound: Unbound "%1$s" from %2$s - re-bind it in the vanilla key settings
key_conflict_wheel.msg.no_conflict_anymo: Only one action is left on %s, so the wheel will no longer pop up
key_conflict_wheel.msg.wheel_empty: Every keybind on %s was cleared, so the wheel will no longer pop up
key_conflict_wheel.hud.help: Press %s to open the wheel: release in the same outer sector = stop, release in the centre = stop all
key_conflict_wheel.menu.title: Key Conflict Wheel · Master Menu
key_conflict_wheel.menu.layout_default: Wheel layout: centred · normal size · buttons default (click to reset)
key_conflict_wheel.menu.layout_custom: Wheel layout: customised (click to reset everything)
key_conflict_wheel.menu.hint1: Master menu key: %s (rebindable in vanilla controls)
key_conflict_wheel.menu.hint2: The wheel pops up when 2 or more actions share one key, except blocked keys.
